d:
Caring for a special needs cat often brings unexpected medical hurdles, severe behavioural struggles, and intense emotional stress for owners. Jackson Galaxy steps in to guide families through complex cases, from paralyzed cat rehabilitation to supporting pets with movement disorders like cerebellar hypoplasia. By addressing dangerous aggression, anxiety, and destructive habits head-on, Jackson works to restore trust inside every household.
Can his proven rehabilitation techniques turn these challenging situations around and give these vulnerable cats the peaceful homes they deserve?
